content.instructions: Choose the one correct answer for each question.

questions.prompt: Which sentence says you have had a fever for three days and still have it?
options: Ich hatte vor drei Tagen Fieber.
Ich habe nach drei Tagen Fieber.
questions.explanation: “seit” plus the dative says how long something has lasted.
The last part of a compound noun decides the article: der Arzt, so der Zahnarzt.

questions.prompt: Which sentence says you have to stay in bed?

options: Ich muss gehe heute zum Arzt.
Ich muss heute zum Arzt gehst.
questions.explanation: After müssen, the second verb is an infinitive at the end of the sentence.
